user.title: The Things Stack (MQTT)
user.description: Credentials from the TTS console under Integrations → MQTT. The API key needs read rights on the application.

data.tenant_id: Tenant ID (TTN: ttn, open source: leave empty)

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the broker. Check host/port.
error.invalid_auth: Connection refused. Check application ID, tenant and API key.

send_downlink.name: Send downlink
send_downlink.description: Queues a downlink for a LoRaWAN device (TTS/TTN). For class A devices it is delivered with the next uplink.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: End device ID in TTS (as in the uplink, e.g. elsys-ers-01).

payload.name: Payload (hex)
payload.description: Payload as a hex string, e.g. 0A0F. Leave empty for an empty downlink (FPort only).

payload_base64.name: Payload (base64)
payload_base64.description: Alternative to Payload (hex): payload directly as base64. Takes precedence if both are set.

application_id.name: Application ID
application_id.description: Only needed if multiple TTS applications are configured and the device cannot be resolved unambiguously.
